visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-second glimpse of a young woman with a natural, clean face, transitioning immediately to a polished, made-up look. Bold pink captions appear at the bottom. The background is a clean, bright white studio setting. (2) A male host with short dark hair and a white t-shirt appears behind the seated woman. He smiles and gestures towards her. Large white text overlays the center of the frame against a modern studio background with vanity mirrors. (3) A close-up shot features a hand holding a tube of 'Blurring Face Primer'. The hand then applies a small amount of the cream to the woman's left cheek, spreading it with a finger to smooth her skin texture. (4) The hand presents a bottle of liquid foundation. A pink makeup sponge is used to gently dab and blend the product across her entire face, ensuring an even and radiant complexion. (5) A four-color concealer palette is shown. A fine brush is used to pick up a peach-toned shade and apply it delicately to the under-eye area and bridge of the nose for brightening. (6) A compact of translucent setting powder is held up. A large fluffy brush sweeps the powder over her face to set the base, while she keeps her eyes closed in a relaxed state. (7) An eye shadow palette with neutral tones is presented. A brush applies a light base color to the lids and lower lash line, followed by a darker rose-brown shade to create depth in the outer corners. (8) The woman's eyelashes are curled with a silver metal curler. A black mascara tube is shown, and the wand is used to coat her lashes, making them appear longer and more defined. (9) A thin eyebrow pencil and a dual-tone eyebrow powder are used in sequence. The host's hand carefully fills in and extends the tail of her eyebrows for a natural, soft look. (10) Contouring powder is applied to the sides of her nose and jawline with a brush. This is followed by two different shades of pink blush applied to the apples of her cheeks for a healthy glow. (11) Three different lip products are layered on her lips. The hand applies the color carefully, resulting in a glossy, multi-dimensional pink-mauve finish. (12) The final look is revealed. The host and the woman pose together, smiling at the camera. The host gestures towards her transformed appearance. The video ends with a black screen and white text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop music begins with a bright synthesizer melody and a steady drum beat. A male voice speaks with high arousal and enthusiasm, greeting the audience in a professional yet friendly tone. (2) A clear 'pop' sound effect triggers as the host introduces the theme. The music continues in the background, maintaining its driving rhythm. (3) Another distinct 'pop' sound marks the introduction of the first makeup product. The narration becomes descriptive, detailing the application process with clear articulation and varied pitch contours. (4) A 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual transition. The music stays consistent as the speaker introduces foundation and concealer, his voice maintaining a positive valence and steady volume. (5) Each new product reveal (powder, eye shadow, mascara) is preceded by a subtle 'pop' or 'ding' sound effect. The BGM remains energetic, with electronic percussion providing a rhythmic bed under the speech. (6) The male voice rises in pitch when expressing admiration ('Wow! Beautiful!'), showing high emotional activation. The background music maintains its loop with no pauses. (7) Final 'pop' sound effects occur during the lip product layering. The speaker's intensity increases towards the end of the video, concluding with a cheerful farewell as the music fades out simultaneously with the speech.
